title: Cardiospermum halicacabum - Love in a puff - Balloon Vine - Mini Plug x1
description:
A tropical, evergreen climber, usually grown as an annual. It has finely
 cut foliage and deliacte twining tendrils. Insignificant white flowers 
are followed by inflated, spherical seed pods, each containing a black 
seed marked with white heart - hence its common name Love-in-a-Puff


  Ultimate Height:
 
 2.5 – 4 metres (reached in approx. 1 year)
 

  Ultimate Spread:
 
 1 – 1.5 metres


   Soil Types:
  
  Chalk, Clay, Loam, Sand
 

   Moisture:
  
  Moist but well‑drained
 

   pH:
  
  Acid, Neutral, or Alkaline
 



   Sun Requirement:
  
  Full sun
 

   Aspect:
  
  East‑facing / South‑facing / West‑facing
 

   Exposure:
  
  Sheltered
 

   Rating:
  
  H1c
 

   Can be grown outside in summer (tolerates 5°C to 10°C)
  

   Requires protection in cooler months
